text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning during the holiday season,
I wake up
to the sound of a gentle
knock at my door.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurriedly open the door to see...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hello, sleepyhead. Happy holidays.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today I've been giving presents to
everyone
that's been good this year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Great question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She opens up her bag to reveal its
contents...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've got Machan dolls, Machan mugs,
Machan
clear folders, and Machan key
chains.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Basically... I have a lot of official URA

merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if it's a result of her racing
success, or
the influence of our
four-panel comics being
compiled into a
book...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the amount of official Aston Machan
merch
that's available has been
increasing shockingly
fast.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm basically a super ultra mascot
already... Well,
near enough.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But the lovely Aston Machan won't stop
here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are still people out there with no
interest in
me, and others with only a
little. I want them to
have my merch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Once they have Machan merch in their
hands,
they'll start to take an interest in
me. That's why
I've been handing out
gifts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I'm probably the last
person who
needs to be convinced to
take an interest in her...
choice_data_list: なるほど、それで……俺にも？
なるほど、それで……私にも？
choice_data_list_en: I see, and that's why... for me too?
I see, and that's why... for me too?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose that's because...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You're an exception.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're one of the nicest ones on my nice
list.
You're super, ultra nice.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You already know how charming I am,
and you
help me share my charms with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Someone as nice as that deserves a
special gift.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open the gift she hands me. Inside the
wrapping
paper... is an album.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This picture was taken on the day my
debut was
decided. It was the day I was
filming that movie
with Vodka and
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This one's from summer camp. I took it
when we
first arrived.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This was our first shrine visit of the new
year. And
that one is from when we
made Valentine's Day
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The album is truly bulky... It's chock full
of
memories both familiar and
forgotten...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I was very particular with my selections.
choice_data_list: それを……もしかして、3年分？
choice_data_list_en: Could that be... three years' worth?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad you like it. That's all that
matters.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I had a lot of fun making it too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll make another one, in three
years'
time. An album every three years.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open the gift she hands me. Inside the
wrapping
paper... is a letter.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'm Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But even though I'm Machan, you're not
allowed
to read that with me here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... I'll see you later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She runs off before I can stop her. I'm
guessing
she put her heart into writing
this letter. I open it
immediately and
begin reading...

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for everything you
do.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I haven't forgotten a single thing you've
done for
me.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make your present special,
so I put a
whole lot of thought into what
I should give you.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
But I ended up confusing myself, so
here's what I
did...

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text: Have you figured it out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The envelope was empty except for the
letter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shake the envelope a little, wondering
if I've
missed something. Then, suddenly,
a refined
fragrance hits me.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
It's a special scent that I made specially.
It doesn't
smell like anyone or anywhere
else.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
So I want you to remember this
fragrance as the
scent of the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text: The holidays you spent with Machan.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Someday, when you're in town, or on the
train, or
at home, I hope you'll
remember today.

text_block_list.name: Machan's Letter
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without even thinking, I glance over
towards the
door she left through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The holiday fragrance drifting about the
room
lingers for a while longer.
